patch_list: Opens the 'Lists' tab by default when tapping 'My Items' instead of the 'Reorder' tab.
Restores the 'Find item' button on linked shopping list items so you can link a different product.
Adds a dedicated 'Flash tag' sibling pill button next to Aisle indicators throughout the app to illuminate electronic shelf tags directly.
Displays real-time in-store stock availability badges on list and checklist items (e.g. In Stock, Low Stock / Only X left, Out of Stock).
Removes the Shop tab entirely from the bottom navigation bar and opens to My Items by default.
Adds a 'Plan my route' map icon to the Walmart 'Shop in-store' checklist screen that opens Walmart's own in-store map with every list item's aisle pinned at once.
